detail.title: Synthesis of Predictive Processing in Musical Temporal Dynamics
detail.summary: This research journal entry synthesizes the role of predictive processing and active inference in musical experience, specifically focusing on how the Action Simulation for Auditory Prediction (ASAP) hypothesis accounts for temporal beat perception and emotional response. We establish a provisional notebook to codify existing evidence and prepare for further inquiry into individual differences and cross-cultural music cognition.

detail.title: Predictive Dynamics in Musical Experience: A Provisional Synthesis
detail.summary: This notebook examines how predictive processing mechanisms, particularly the ASAP hypothesis, bridge the gap between auditory signal processing and the subjective experience of music.
detail.reason: Synthesis of existing evidence base supports the operationalization of music_experience project findings into a provisional notebook.
